analysis_role: PROTOTYPE ANALYSIS grid for M0-A (HiRISE-derived 2 m). Not the ROI-A dataset; not in web/public/data.
vertical_reference: UNVERIFIED: USGS HiRISE DTM tied to MOLA ('DeltaGeoid' in the file name); stereo pairs C/W/DL differ by up to 2.4 m (constant offsets); this box is pair C only
nodata_policy: NaN in dem = no source data (any NaN in a 2x2 block), never filled; validity 1 = not routable

semantic_resolution.note: 2 m posting of a 1 m stereo DTM; effective terrain resolution is coarser (several metres). Rocks below that are not represented. Ortho is display only.
